papers.title: MMInA: Benchmarking Multihop Multimodal Internet Agents
papers.authors: Shulin Tian, Ziniu Zhang, Liangyu Chen, Ziwei Liu
papers.affiliations: S-Lab, Nanyang Technological University
papers.intro: 本文提出了MMInA基准，包含1050个人工撰写的多跳多模态任务，在14个真实动态网站上评估智能体的跨网站浏览能力，并发现现有模型（如GPT-4V）在长链任务中早期跳步表现差，为此提出了一种轻量级记忆增强方法提升性能。

papers.title: Enhancing Mobile "How-to" Queries with Automated Search Results Verification and Reranking
papers.authors: Lei Ding, Jeshwanth Bheemanpally, Yi Zhang
papers.affiliations: University of California, Santa Cruz
papers.intro: 本文提出一个三阶段自动验证与重排系统，通过AI代理在Android设备上模拟执行网页中提取的指令，基于执行成功指标对搜索结果进行重排，从而提升技术指导类查询结果的准确性和可靠性。

papers.title: LlamaTouch: A Faithful and Scalable Testbed for Mobile UI Task Automation
papers.authors: Li Zhang, Shihe Wang, Xianqing Jia, Zhihan Zheng, Yunhe Yan, Longxi Gao, Yuanchun Li, Mengwei Xu
papers.affiliations: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications（Li Zhang, Shihe Wang, Xianqing Jia, Zhihan Zheng, Yunhe Yan, Longxi Gao, Mengwei Xu）；Tsinghua University（Yuanchun Li）
papers.intro: LlamaTouch提出了一种基于关键状态（essential states）匹配的评估新方法，通过比较智能体执行轨迹与人工标注的必要的应用/系统状态，在真实移动设备上实现忠实且可扩展的移动UI任务自动化评估。

papers.title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
papers.authors: Tianbao Xie, Danyang Zhang, Jixuan Chen, Xiaochuan Li, Siheng Zhao, Ruisheng Cao, Toh Jing Hua, Zhoujun Cheng, Dongchan Shin, Fangyu Lei, Yitao Liu, Yiheng Xu, Shuyan Zhou, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Victor Zhong, Tao Yu
papers.tags: gui, multimodal learning, visual grounding, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: The University of Hong Kong (♠), CMU (♣), Salesforce Research (♡), University of Waterloo (♢)
papers.intro: 提出了 OSWorld，首个可扩展的、基于真实操作系统的多模态智能体基准环境，包含369个真实计算机任务，评估发现当前最先进的VLM智能体成功率仅12.24%，远低于人类的72.36%，揭示了其在GUI接地和操作知识上的严重不足。

papers.title: Autonomous Evaluation and Refinement of Digital Agents
papers.authors: Jiayi Pan, Yichi Zhang, Nicholas Tomlin, Yifei Zhou, Sergey Levine, Alane Suhr
papers.affiliations: UC Berkeley, University of Michigan
papers.intro: 本文提出利用领域通用的自动评估模型（端到端VLM或模块化字幕-推理方法）来评估数字智能体轨迹，并通过推理时引导和过滤行为克隆显著提升智能体性能，无需额外专家演示或评估函数。

papers.title: VisualWebBench: How Far Have Multimodal LLMs Evolved in Web Page Understanding and Grounding?
papers.authors: Junpeng Liu, Yifan Song, Bill Yuchen Lin, Wai Lam, Graham Neubig, Yuanzhi Li, Xiang Yue
papers.tags: multimodal learning, OCR, visual grounding, scene understanding, gui
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, School of Computer Science, Peking University, MBZUAI, Allen Institute for AI
papers.intro: 提出VisualWebBench，一个包含七项任务、涵盖139个真实网站共1.5K人工精选实例的多模态基准，用于系统评估MLLMs在网页理解（感知、OCR、语义理解）和接地（元素定位、动作预测）方面的能力。

papers.title: Ferret-UI: Grounded Mobile UI Understanding with Multimodal LLMs
papers.authors: Keen You, Haotian Zhang, Eldon Schoop, Floris Weers, Amanda Swearngin, Jeffrey Nichols, Yinfei Yang, Zhe Gan
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual grounding, OCR, gui
papers.affiliations: Apple
papers.intro: 提出Ferret-UI，一种专门用于移动UI屏幕理解的多模态大语言模型，通过“任意分辨率”策略增强对小物体的感知，并在指代、定位和推理任务上全面超越GPT-4V等现有模型。

papers.title: AutoWebGLM: A Large Language Model-based Web Navigating Agent
papers.authors: Hanyu Lai, Xiao Liu, Iat Long Iong, Shuntian Yao, Yuxuan Chen, Pengbo Shen, Hao Yu, Hanchen Zhang, Xiaohan Zhang, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University; Zhipu AI; Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: 提出基于ChatGLM3-6B的AutoWebGLM代理，通过HTML简化算法、混合人机数据构建、课程学习、强化学习和拒绝采样微调，在多个Web导航基准上超越GPT-4，实现了接近人类水平的性能。

papers.title: Octopus v2: On-device language model for super agent
papers.authors: Wei Chen, Zhiyuan Li
papers.affiliations: Stanford University
papers.intro: 本文提出Octopus v2，一个基于Gemma-2B的agent模型，通过引入功能令牌（functional tokens）将函数名预测转化为单token分类，在准确率上超越GPT-4，同时延迟降低35倍、上下文长度减少95%，为边缘环境下的AI agent部署提供了实用方案。

papers.title: Octopus: On-device language model for function calling of software APIs
papers.authors: Wei Chen, Zhiyuan Li, Mingyuan Ma
papers.affiliations: Stanford University, Harvard University
papers.intro: 提出Octopus框架，通过精心构建的API数据集微调2B至7B小模型，并引入条件掩码推理技术，使设备端模型在软件API调用任务上超越GPT-4。

papers.title: AgentStudio: A Toolkit for Building General Virtual Agents
papers.authors: Longtao Zheng, Zhiyuan Huang, Zhenghai Xue, Xinrun Wang, Bo An, Shuicheng Yan
papers.affiliations: NTU (Longtao Zheng, Zhenghai Xue, Bo An), Skywork AI (Bo An, Shuicheng Yan), ETH Zurich (Zhiyuan Huang), NUS (Shuicheng Yan), SMU (Xinrun Wang)
papers.intro: AgentStudio是一个集环境、工具和基准于一体的开放工具包，通过提供通用观测/动作空间、交互式环境和配套标注/评估工具，系统评测智能体在GUI接地、视频学习、成功检测等方面的基础能力，并发布了包含205个真实世界任务的在线基准。

papers.title: Segment Anything Model for Road Network Graph Extraction
papers.authors: Congrui Hetang; Haoru Xue; Cindy Le; Tianwei Yue; Wenping Wang; Yihui He
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, Columbia University
papers.intro: 论文提出SAM-Road，通过微调SAM作为图像编码器，结合轻量级分割几何解码器和transformer图神经网络拓扑解码器，实现快速、大规模的道路网络图矢量化提取，在精度与SOTA相当的同时速度提升40-80倍。

papers.title: InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models for Multimodal Video Understanding
papers.authors: Yi Wang, Kunchang Li, Xinhao Li, Jiashuo Yu, Yinan He, Chenting Wang, Guo Chen, Baoqi Pei, Ziang Yan, Rongkun Zheng, Jilan Xu, Zun Wang, Yansong Shi, Tianxiang Jiang, Songze Li, Hongjie Zhang, Yifei Huang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Limin Wang
papers.affiliations: OpenGVLab, Shanghai AI Laboratory; Nanjing University; Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, CAS
papers.intro: InternVideo2通过三阶段渐进式训练——无掩码视频token重建、跨模态对比学习、下一token预测——将视频编码器扩展到6B参数，并在60多个视频/音频任务上取得领先性能，同时具备长视频理解和对话推理能力。

papers.title: Cradle: Empowering Foundation Agents Towards General Computer Control
papers.authors: Weihao Tan, Wentao Zhang, Xinrun Xu, Haochong Xia, Ziluo Ding, Boyu Li, Bohan Zhou, Junpeng Yue, Jiechuan Jiang, Yewen Li, Ruyi An, Molei Qin, Chuqiao Zong, Longtao Zheng, Yujie Wu, Xiaoqiang Chai, Yifei Bi, Tianbao Xie, Pengjie Gu, Xiyun Li, Ceyao Zhang, Long Tian, Chaojie Wang, Xinrun Wang, Börje F. Karlsson, Bo An, Shuicheng Yan, Zongqing Lu
papers.affiliations: Skywork AI, Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence, Nanyang Technological University (Singapore), Peking University, Institute of Software (Chinese Academy of Sciences), The University of Hong Kong, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen)
papers.intro: 本文提出Cradle，一个基于大型多模态模型（LMM）的模块化框架，首次实现了通过统一接口（屏幕截图→键盘鼠标动作）在AAA游戏、多种软件及OSWorld基准上完成复杂长时任务，展示了通用计算机控制的重要进展。

papers.title: Android in the Zoo: Chain-of-Action-Thought for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Jiwen Zhang, Jihao Wu, Yihua Teng, Minghui Liao, Nuo Xu, Xiao Xiao, Zhongyu Wei, Duyu Tang
papers.affiliations: Fudan University, Huawei Inc
papers.intro: 本文提出Chain-of-Action-Thought（CoAT）提示范式，通过显式建模屏幕描述、动作思考、动作描述和动作结果来丰富GUI导航的语义信息，并构建了包含18643个带CoAT标注的屏幕-动作对的数据集Android-In-The-Zoo（AITZ），实验证明该方法显著提升了多种多模态模…

papers.title: OmniACT: A Dataset and Benchmark for Enabling Multimodal Generalist Autonomous Agents for Desktop and Web
papers.authors: Raghav Kapoor, Yash Parag Butala, Melisa Russak, Jing Yu Koh, Kiran Kamble, Waseem Alshikh, Ruslan Salakhutdinov
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University（Raghav Kapoor, Yash Parag Butala, Jing Yu Koh, Ruslan Salakhutdinov）； Writer.com（Melisa Russak, Kiran Kamble, Waseem AlShikh）
papers.intro: 提出OmniACT数据集和基准，要求智能体根据屏幕截图和自然语言任务生成可执行的PyAutoGUI脚本，覆盖桌面和网页应用，实验显示最强模型GPT-4仅达到人类水平的15%。

papers.title: On the Multi-turn Instruction Following for Conversational Web Agents
papers.authors: Yang Deng, Xuan Zhang, Wenxuan Zhang, Yifei Yuan, See-Kiong Ng, Tat-Seng Chua
papers.affiliations: National University of Singapore, DAMO Academy (Alibaba Group), University of Copenhagen
papers.intro: 本文提出了一个新的对话式网页导航任务和MT-Mind2Web数据集，并设计了一个自反思记忆增强规划框架（Self-MAP），通过多面记忆检索与自我反思技术解决多轮指令跟随中的上下文依赖和长序列问题。

papers.title: Improving Language Understanding from Screenshots
papers.authors: Tianyu Gao, Zirui Wang, Adithya Bhaskar, Danqi Chen
papers.affiliations: Princeton Language and Intelligence (PLI), Princeton University
papers.intro: 论文提出一种新颖的Patch-and-Text Prediction (PTP)预训练目标，通过同时预测截图中的图像块和文本，让截图语言模型在仅以视觉为输入的情况下，在GLUE上达到与BERT相当的性能。

papers.title: YOLOv9: Learning What You Want to Learn Using Programmable Gradient Information
papers.authors: Chien-Yao Wang, I-Hau Yeh, Hong-Yuan Mark Liao
papers.affiliations: Institute of Information Science, Academia Sinica, Taiwan National Taipei University of Technology, Taiwan Department of Information and Computer Engineering, Chung Yuan Christian University, Taiwan
papers.intro: 本文提出可编程梯度信息（PGI）和广义高效层聚合网络（GELAN），从信息瓶颈和可逆函数角度解决深度网络中的信息丢失问题，使得从头训练的模型在目标检测任务上优于使用大数据集预训练的最先进方法。

papers.title: CoCo-Agent: A Comprehensive Cognitive MLLM Agent for Smartphone GUI Automation
papers.authors: Xinbei Ma, Zhuosheng Zhang, Hai Zhao
papers.affiliations: 上海交通大学（School of Electronic Information and Electrical Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Key Laboratory of Shanghai Education Commission for Intelligent Interaction and Cognitive Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai Key Laboratory of Trusted Data Circulation and Governance in Web3）
papers.intro: CoCo-Agent 提出综合环境感知（CEP）和条件动作预测（CAP）两个创新方法，基于LLaVA骨干在智能手机GUI自动化任务上实现了新的最优性能，通过细致化感知和结构化动作分解系统性地提升了智能体在真实场景中的表现。
